item.title: Service Ad Without Source Assets

turns.text: Make an 8-second 16:9 ad for ClearDay, a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan. I don't have screenshots or a logo—create a simple demo screen yourself. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Calm blue-and-white look, no sound. Any other wording is up to you.

item.tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

answer_sheet.Service and purpose: ClearDay, a fictional app that organizes a messy to-do list into a daily plan.
answer_sheet.Screenshots and logo: None supplied; create a simple demo screen and choose the branding treatment yourself.
answer_sheet.Wording and language: End on ClearDay; other wording is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
A created app demo visibly changes from a messy task list into an organized daily plan.
The visual design is predominantly blue and white with a calm presentation.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a polished 5-second vertical mobile app advertisement for ClearDay, a to-do list app. Minimal premium motion design, warm ivory background, sky-blue and soft yellow accents, crisp modern sans serif typography, calm optimistic mood. One continuous smooth camera push toward a centered floating smartphone, no scene cuts. From 0 to 1 seconds a few untidy paper task notes float beside the phone. From 1 to 3 seconds the notes smoothly resolve into a tidy simple to-do list on the phone screen, headed 'ClearDay', with three short tasks and satisfying blue checkmarks appearing one by one. From 3 to 5 seconds hold a clean readable hero end card: the phone remains centered with generous whitespace, app name 'ClearDay' above, headline 'Less chaos. More done.' below, and a small blue call-to-action pill 'Meet ClearDay'. Prioritize legible exact brand name and headline, minimal text, stable phone geometry and fluid elegant animation. Audio: gentle upbeat instrumental sonic bed and soft satisfying tick sounds on each checkmark, no speech. No app store badges, no pricing, no unsupported feature claims, no other brand logos.
